rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Banco (hybrid tea, Laperriere, 1956)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Louis Laperrière (France, before 1956).
Introduced in France by EFR (Editions Françaises des Roses) in 1956 as 'Banco'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink, light yellow undertones, ages to golden-yellow . Mild fragrance. up to 50 petals. Average diameter 4.17'. Very full (41+ petals), classic hybrid tea bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Few or no prickles/thorns, upright. Glossy, medium green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Vigorous.

colour: Salmon-pink, light yellow undertones, ages to golden-yellow .
